title: Indigo Blue Zigzag Print Cotton Tunic Top for Women – Short Kurti for Jeans
description:
Lehar means wave – bold indigo and white zigzags that move like water.

A classic indigo blue cotton tunic printed with vertical white zigzag stripes, with a soft speckled texture in the print. A mandarin collar with a front slit and a short button placket keep it neat, and the curved hem looks great over jeans.

✦ The Details
• Mandarin collar with a front V-slit
• Short button placket with three buttons
• 3/4 sleeves
• Straight cut with a curved hem, hip length
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton with a classic indigo-and-white print – a colour pairing that has been part of Rajasthani textiles for centuries.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit; the vertical zigzags draw the eye up and down, so the tunic looks long and lean. Choose your usual top size.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue jeans, clear heels and long oxidised earrings, as in our photos; white trousers for office; a flower in your hair and flats for a holiday.

✦ Why Indigo
Indigo is the easiest print to wear every week – it goes with blue jeans, white trousers and black alike, and looks smart at the office without trying.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
